sources.classification: Public historical observations, not live measured breadth, not as-of dissemination snapshots
sources.target: WVHT^2 * APD, m^2 s; wave activity proxy, not electricity

methods.availability: Daily updates from previously issued forecasts only after target timestamp plus 30 minutes is strictly before update time
methods.calibration: Ridge trained before September 2023; static champions selected on September-December 2023
methods.evaluation: Prequential 2025; fixed candidate rules, weights adapt only to earlier matured 2025 errors
methods.uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap replicates, 7-calendar-day blocks plus 14-day sensitivity; Holm over all 108 predeclared comparisons
methods.promotion_rule: At least 5 percent gain, adjusted p<0.05, positive 7/14-day interval lower limits, at least 2000 pairs and 120 days, 80 percent exact-target coverage; must pass against all three comparators
methods.novelty_boundary: New LumenCore research implementation using standard expert-aggregation ingredients. No proprietary novelty or theoretical regret guarantee established.

selected_results.decision: HOLD: insufficient incremental gain over stronger baselines
HOLD: does not clear all stronger-comparator effect/statistical gates
HOLD: an 11.27 percent gain versus an obsolete selected Ridge model does not establish superiority versus persistence

prediction_interval_calibration.interpretation: Nominal intervals undercovered in every scored cell; not a calibrated safety guarantee

station46237_one_hour_10pct_input_dropou.interpretation: Long complete-lag feature vectors are brittle to scattered missing readings. Error comparisons across corruption scenarios are conditional on different available forecast origins, not identical samples.

edge_cases.regime_concentration: 42001 six-hour router improved in Q2/Q3 but not Q4; its error on calibration-defined high-activity cases was unchanged from the static champion. Do not infer storm-performance improvement from aggregate gains.

next_research_priority: Predeclare missingness-aware short-history experts and better uncertainty calibration. Check adverse-regime performance and a fresh evaluation period before any new promotion. Do not keep tuning on this now-examined 2025 result as if it were untouched.
claim_boundary: Internal offline wave forecasting research only. No validated geothermal transfer, live plant control, energy-yield increase, revenue, valuation, independent certification, or production deployment. Main and DNS were not modified.
